import json,hashlib; from pathlib import Path; import numpy as np
r=Path('/run');c=json.loads((r/'inputs/RUN_CONTRACT.json').read_text());checks=[]
for b in c['baselines']:
    p=Path('/ref')/Path(b['original_H_path']).relative_to('/home/KMS/DRIVE_SIM_ROUTES_20261007_01a11669/source')
    old=np.load(p,mmap_mode='r',allow_pickle=False)[b['original_pose_ids']]
    new=np.load(r/'baseline'/b['route']/'mount0/H_full.npy',allow_pickle=False)
    a,d=old.tobytes(order='C'),new.tobytes(order='C')
    checks.append(dict(route=b['route'],pose_ids=b['original_pose_ids'],byte_equal=a==d,original_bytes_sha256=hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest(),regenerated_bytes_sha256=hashlib.sha256(d).hexdigest()))
passed=all(x['byte_equal'] for x in checks)
with (r/'BASELINE_BYTE_CHECK.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(dict(status='PASS' if passed else 'FAIL',checks=checks),f,indent=2)
assert passed
print('PASS: all nine baseline poses have identical H bytes')
